description_en: Adds an IP entry to an access control policy group
description_zh: 在访问控制策略组中添加IP条目
kebab_example: aliyun vpc add-ipv6-translator-acl-list-entry --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id ipv6transacl-bp1dcdvfe20000 --acl-entry-ip 12XX:0:0:XXXX::0102 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddIPv6TranslatorAclListEntry

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the access control policy group
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略组的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access control policy group to which the IP entry belongs
parameters.help_zh: IP条目的访问控制策略组ID。
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en: The IPv6 address or IPv6 CIDR block to add to the access control policy group entry. Example: 12XX:0:0:XXXX::0102 or 12XX:0:0:XXXX::/60
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略组条目中要添加的单个IPv6地址或IPv6地址段，例如12XX:0:0:XXXX::0102或12XX:0:0:XXXX::/60
parameters.name: acl_entry_ip

parameters.help_en:
The description of the access control policy group entry.

The description must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, or Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略组条目的备注信息。

长度为2~100个字符，以英文大小字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: acl_entry_comment

AclEntryId.description_en: The ID of the access control policy group entry
